pick.headline: Ethnic clashes in Tirgu Mures
pick.summary: On March 19-20, 1990, Romanians and ethnic Hungarians clashed violently in the Transylvanian city of Tirgu Mures, leaving several dead.
pick.significance: The violence was the worst ethnic clash in post-communist Romania and alarmed Hungary.
pick.fbis: The East Europe Daily Report (issue date not shown) carried Budapest radio of March 17 on anti-Magyar actions in Transylvania: in Tirgu Mures a Hungarian-language pharmacy sign drew a crowd that swelled to thousands, journalists' equipment was smashed, and 14 people were hurt.

alternates.headline: Argentine workers land on South Georgia
alternates.summary: On March 19, 1982, Argentine scrap-metal workers landed at Leith on South Georgia and raised the Argentine flag.
alternates.significance: The incident escalated into the Argentine invasion of the Falklands two weeks later.
alternates.fbis: The Latin America Daily Report of March 23, 1982, carried Buenos Aires TELAM on an Argentine Foreign Ministry communique about the navy transport Bahia Buen Suceso landing a contractor's personnel on South Georgia, who remained on the island.
